answer: New accounts start on a small island, a cohort of forty newcomers who keep each other honest. Each epoch every member sends a short pulse to five random cohort-mates: signed proof of a fresh ninety-second task from a public pool. A member that goes hollow, answering with copied or empty work, is reported by its peers; two reports in six epochs freeze the whole island until a full re-audit, holding every member's 200-token deposit. A hundred fakes then need five hundred fresh tasks per epoch, twelve hours of real work, with twenty thousand tokens at risk.
